channel.description: Latest articles from Place North West (placenorthwest.co.uk)

item.title: L&G continues Greater Manchester homes drive
item.description: The investor's affordable homes division has added to its growing pipeline in the city region with deals in Salford and Oldham totaling 264 homes. The post L&G continues Greater Manchester homes drive appeared first on Place North West.

item.title: Start made on Penrith school expansion
item.description: Work has begun on extending Beaconside Church of England Primary School, creating additional school places and enhancing provision for children with special educational needs and disabilities. The post Start made on Penrith school expansion appeared first on Place North West.

item.title: 900-home Kendal opportunity mapped out
item.description: Kendal Futures, the public/private partnership set up to drive forward the regeneration of the Cumbrian town, has identified five sites totaling 88 acres that could be redeveloped into homes for around 2,000 people. The post 900-home Kendal opportunity mapped out appeared first on Place North West.

item.title: Knauf plans £180m Flintshire insulation factory
item.description: Situated at Deeside Industrial Park, the proposed facility would be capable of producing more than 100,000 tonnes of non-combustible glass and rock mineral wool insulation each year. The post Knauf plans £180m Flintshire insulation factory appeared first on Place North West.

item.title: Duo promoted to deliver and fill £1bn MIX Manchester
item.description: Manchester Airport Group’s Helen Ratcliffe and Emily Fleet have been made head of agency and development and head of delivery respectively, as the 60-acre regeneration project gathers pace. The post Duo promoted to deliver and fill £1bn MIX Manchester appeared first on Place North West.

item.title: BOOK NOW | The Future is Female
item.description: Join Place North West, Close Brothers Property Finance, and Velux as we celebrate and explore the ways women are transforming their communities through property development and regeneration. The post BOOK NOW | The Future is Female appeared first on Place North West.

item.title: Holker puts in for 62 Cumbrian homes
item.description: A 7.7-acre greenfield site northeast of Kirkby-in-Furness is the subject of the housebuilder’s outline application to Westmorland and Furness Council. The post Holker puts in for 62 Cumbrian homes appeared first on Place North West.

item.title: Piccadilly Gardens to be fenced off for 18 months
item.description: Manchester City Council is preparing to erect hoardings around the maligned public square in March so that investigative and enabling works relating to its redevelopment can be carried out. The post Piccadilly Gardens to be fenced off for 18 months appeared first on Place North West.

item.title: Breck eyes four-acre former sweet factory for affordable homes
item.description: The vacant Valeo Foods factory off Edge Lane would be pulled down and replaced with 69 houses and apartments. The post Breck eyes four-acre former sweet factory for affordable homes appeared first on Place North West.

item.title: Placefirst’s Mawson moves upstairs
item.description: The built-to-rent developer and operator’s chief executive David Mawson will become its executive chair in February, sparking the hunt for a successor. The post Placefirst’s Mawson moves upstairs appeared first on Place North West.
